subject: Eiffel Tower
hook: EIFFEL TOWER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The Eiffel Tower was partially financed by predatory loans extracted from Haiti as part of an indemnity payment to former French slaveholders, effectively linking the monument to the economic strangulation of the first independent Black republic.
angle_support: During the period of the tower's construction, the CIC was acquiring funds from predatory loans to the National Bank of Haiti, some of which went towards the financing of the tower.
These loans were connected to an indemnity controversy that saw France force Haiti's government to financially compensate French slaveowners for lost income as a result of the Haitian Revolution
title: The Dark Financial Secret of the Eiffel Tower
description: The Eiffel Tower is often celebrated as a pinnacle of engineering and French liberty. However, its construction was partially financed by a bank profiting from predatory loans that crippled Haiti's economy for generations.
narration: EIFFEL TOWER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a monument to French liberty. It was closer to a tool for global debt extraction. The construction relied on funds tied to a crushing secret. The bank financing Gustave Eiffel gathered capital through predatory loans forced upon Haiti. These payments compensated former slaveholders for their losses. Effectively, wealth siphoned from the first independent Black republic directly funded this iconic iron landmark. A symbol of national pride built upon a nation's forced bankruptcy.
